build_hdf5_dataset: build a HuggingFace dataset from HDF5 files using the HDF5 ArrowBasedBuilder class
create_hdf5_config: create an HDF5Config with custom batch_size and features for the HDF5 builder
infer_hdf5_features: infer HuggingFace Features from an HDF5 file using _recursive_infer_features
convert_complex_to_nested: convert a complex numpy array to a PyArrow StructArray with real and imag fields
load_hdf5_arrays: load HDF5 datasets as PyArrow tables using _recursive_load_arrays with start and end indices
